card.name: Words just before 'water' as a liquid
card.fires_on: Small modifying or linking words that come right before the word water (plain, cool, sterile, of, and) in drinking, rinsing or diluent instructions.

modes.label: Adjective before water
modes.description: Plain, cool or sterile placed directly before the word water.
modes.example: Take FOSAMAX at least one-half hour before the first food, beverage, or medication of the day with<< plain>> water only

modes.label: Linking word before a liquid
modes.description: Of or and in a glass of water or in a list of IV fluids or diluents.
modes.example: Add 75 mL<< of>> Ora-Plus ®* oral susp

card.writes: It pushes the model toward a following word like water or a fluid name, though the promoted tokens look unrelated.
card.plain: It fires on the word just ahead of 'water' in instructions for swallowing, rinsing or diluting a drug.
